capabilities: Read descriptions from README, index, or same-name notes
Read subfolder descriptions from a parent folder table
extras: Desktop only, since phones have no hover. Makes no network requests and collects no data. Descriptions are limited to the first 280 characters. Independently developed, not endorsed by Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer shows only folder names, giving no hint of what a folder contains without opening it.
summary: File explorer tooltip that shows a folder's description from its README note or a parent folder's table on hover.
